expectation.note: Etc/GMT+5 is UTC-05:00. An engine that maps the identifier to +05:00 is ten hours wrong.

normative_evidence.note: the Etc/GMT[+-]N zones follow the POSIX TZ sign convention, which is the opposite of ISO 8601

rationale: A documented, normative sign inversion that is nonetheless one of the most common zone-handling defects.
title: Etc/GMT+5 has a NEGATIVE offset (POSIX sign inversion)
